items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I do remember very well that Count Basie was playing at a place where he just played with a drummer. And he was very, very kind to me. I used to go in and sit in with him.

ctx.x: Then after that, he asked me if I would make, you know, some albums for him. And I made one, I believe, in February of '76 and a few weeks later, I made one with ... Dizzy Gillespie and I and the rhythm section, and then a few weeks later, made another with Clark Terry, Count Basie, Lockjaw Davis ... oh, who else was on that one; I think Louie Bellson. But that's about 3 in about 3 months, and now I'm scheduled to make another one on the 23rd of this month, which is just about 10 days away.
So you suddenly have a new rush of album activity?

items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It was Count Basie—or Bill Basie, I might say—me on alto, and then a drummer, whose name I forget at the moment.

ctx.x: You were eventually . . . well, your family was about to move to Harlem, but before you did, you were already going up to Harlem, I gather, and sitting in. Do you remember any of your earliest opportunities to sit in?

Well, I went up to Harlem quite a bit because there was no place in San Juan Hill, where, you know, in my area, that I could go and sit in. One of the people who was kindest to me when I really wasn’t playing very well was Bill Basie. Now, he later became known as Count Basie. But he played at a club called Leroy’s on 135th Street and Lennox Avenue. It was Count Basie—or Bill Basie, I might say—me on alto, and then a drummer, whose name I forget at the moment. But it was just . . . that was the trio, and again…
Do you remember what sort of things you’d be playing in an engagement like that?

items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: I had a chance to work with Benny maybe about a couple weeks or something like that before he went to doing something else.

ctx.x: I had a chance to work with Benny maybe about a couple weeks or something like that before he went to doing something else. There's a whole thing if I can put together about Bennett.
